profile.legalName: Tech Exposure & Access Through Mentoring Inc
profile.summary: TEAM Inc. is an Oakland nonprofit that trains and mentors Black and Brown youth ages 14-24 who are underrepresented in sports and data analytics. It offers coding skills training and mentorship through bootcamps and core programs.

review.notes: The agenda names Tech Exposure and Access through Mentoring (TEAM, Inc.) in Oakland. ProPublica lists the 501(c)(3) of that name in Oakland (EIN 81-3838152), and the website shows the same EIN, the 1441 Franklin St address, the contact email and the youth mentoring and coding programs. The summary matches the site's wording and is neutral.
